reels.title: Democrats, high prices and the AI economy
reels.summary:
A blue wave has swept Washington, but many of the forces shaping the US economy remain out of their hands, with the Nasdaq tumbling as chipmakers sank on fears of tougher AI regulation. US economics editor Dan Burns and host Carmel Crimmins discuss the levers in the hands of Democrats when it comes to AI, billionaires and stubborn inflation.
 
https://www.reuters.com/podcasts/democrats-win-big-now

reels.title: Wall St slumps as sharp tech losses put Nasdaq on course for correction
reels.summary:
The Nasdaq Composite ended sharply lower, notching its deepest one-day drop in 19 months and confirming it was in a correction, as chipmakers sank on ‌fears of tougher AI regulation after Democrats won control of the US Congress.
